title: Flutter app scaffold and test harness
description: As a developer I need a buildable Flutter app with a test runner so each requirement has a runnable test
acceptance_criteria: App builds on the target platform; test command runs and reports per requirement ID

title: Time model
description: As a user I want event times stored in UTC with their zone and shown in my Local zone and format
acceptance_criteria: TIM-01; TIM-02; TIM-03; TIM-04; TIM-05; TIM-06; TIM-10 each pass their tests

title: Theme tokens and fonts
description: As a user I want the light and dark Soft palette and IBM Plex fonts

title: Shared dropdown and instant apply
description: As a user I want one dropdown behaviour and changes shown at once

title: Month view and navigation
description: As a user I want a Month calendar I can navigate with today marked
acceptance_criteria: CAL-01.a; CAL-01.b (Month and Week only); CAL-01.d; CAL-01.i pass

title: Week view hourly grid
description: As a user I want a Week view with an hourly grid and week navigation

title: Remaining views and view picker
description: As a user I want 5-day Day and List views and an icon view picker
acceptance_criteria: Rest of CAL-01.b; CAL-06.c; CAL-01.j pass

title: Calendar filter
description: As a user I want to filter calendars

title: Message keys and localization
description: As a user I want every message in my language from the message files
acceptance_criteria: Messages are read from requirements/messages/*.arb by key; a missing key falls back to English (msg: rows SHL-02.a-b); the picker/header messages in sprint 002 are cited by key

title: Remaining time-zone and header work
description: As a user I want the device time zone preference and temporary calendar zone to work independently
acceptance_criteria: SET-02.a; remaining CAL-02.a and CAL-06.a-d for the responsive header and delivered controls; verify restart persistence

title: Calendar height
description: As a user I want to change how tall the calendar is and adjust hour density
acceptance_criteria: CAL-04.b-d; CAL-04.g; CAL-04.j; use the shared UIC-16 resize bar

title: Stable event notes during notification changes
description: As a user I want notes to stay steady when notifications resize the event popup
acceptance_criteria: EVT-01.s; test add and remove at desktop and narrow widths with preserved text and selection, no transient jump, and reachable controls

title: Flutter Material 3 color theming
description: As a user I want a consistent light and dark theme with my saved colors preserved
acceptance_criteria: THM-02, THM-09, UIC-10, UIC-20, and EVT-03.b/i; generate both schemes with seed #93B4FF, use theme defaults and scheme choices, preserve explicit colors and provider IDs, and retire previous app color prescriptions

title: Current-view calendar Print Preview
description: As a user I want to preview and print the calendar period I am looking at
acceptance_criteria: CAL-05 and PRT-01 current-view slice: visible period and view, active filters and time zone, automatic orientation, equivalent preview and output, cancel keeps calendar view unchanged

title: Local calendar management
description: As a user I want to create, rename, choose a default, and safely delete device-local calendars
acceptance_criteria: CLCL-01.a-c, CLCL-01.e/h, CLCL-03.a-b and local portions of CON-02.a and CON-04; persist changes; delete empty non-last calendars, protect occupied non-last calendars, and confirm clearing events in the last calendar while retaining its identity; reflect changes in event editing and FLT-01.a/e
